source: Derived from .claude/skills/brand-design-systems/brands/ollama.md (paper-white documentation-first system, pure black ink, system sans, terminal-card with CLI green).

token_notes.accent: #157F3C is a deepened version of Ollama's terminal-green (the CLI success / traffic-light green). It reads as the local-and-go signal and clears the 3.0:1 contrast floor on white, where the literal #27C93F would not.
token_notes.fonts: Ollama's heading face is SF Pro Rounded (Apple-licensed, not bundled). Inter is the brand's own stated body match for system-ui and is used across the board for a faithful documentation feel.
